text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Trai-chan, analysis time. Let's figure out why we lost.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmm.
Stamina consumption pace, and racecraft.
Or is top speed itself the fundamental issue?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, dammit~~!
There was so much more I could've tried~!
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all in the next race, too!
If I stop, the 'unknown' will slip further away!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Everything I couldn't try out today,
I'm definitely gonna nail—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Why don't we show 'em what we've got?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Exactly! We have to keep running.
The 'unknown' only lies beyond that."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright~. I'm winning this time.
Together with you, Trai-chan!
